title: E1 fix round 2: renames counted on both paths, security_paths_empty gets the security tier and checklist, orchestrator/*.py in the list (from review T-0224)
spec:
Fix round on task/T-0223 (commit 6005a54 on top of d8531a3 and goal/T-0201). STEP 0: your worktree was cut from goal/T-0201; run `git reset --hard task/T-0223` first and confirm `git log --oneline -1` shows 6005a54. Then address the opus review T-0224 in orchestrator/daemon.py, .orchestrator/pool.toml, tests/test_daemon.py:
1. changed_paths(): pass --no-renames (or -M0) so a renamed guarded file lists both the old and the new path; a rename of .claude/hooks/x.sh out of the glob must still match. Also list deleted paths (already the case; keep a test).
2. _review_plan()/gate(): the fail-closed reasons diff_unavailable, security_paths:* and security_paths_empty all take the same branch: one review on security_review_tier (other tier when it equals the executor's model) with the security checklist forced (pass complexity max(t complexity, 7) or an explicit security flag the review prompt honours). Make the docstring and code agree.
3. pool.toml security_paths: replace the per-module list with orchestrator/*.py plus the non-Python entries (hooks, settings, pool.toml, protected-paths, .mcp*.json, prompts, skills, Dockerfile, compose, pyproject.toml, uv.lock); mirror in DEFAULT_SECURITY_PATHS.
Tests: real-repo rename test (git mv .claude/hooks/a.sh moved.sh matches), test_empty_security_paths_fails_closed asserts tier == security_review_tier (or the other tier) and the checklist marker in the created review's spec/complexity, glob test for orchestrator/cli.py. Commit on the task branch when green.
acceptance: git log on the task branch contains 6005a54 and d8531a3 below the fix commit
All tests from T-0223 still pass; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0 in the worktree

constraints.planner_note: complexity 3 on purpose: two opus reviews (T-0221, T-0224) already ran on this change; remaining items are one med and two low; merges directly at a green gate per the 2026-09-19 review decision

result.summary:
## Summary

Fixed the three issues from opus review T-0224 on top of T-0223 (6005a54):

1. **`changed_paths()` rename blindness** — added `--no-renames` to the `git diff` call, so a renamed guarded file (e.g. `.claude/hooks/x.sh` → `x.sh`) reports as delete-old + add-new instead of collapsing into one `R100` entry that would silently drop the still-matching old path.
2. **Fail-closed branch split** — `gate()`'s `security` check only covered `diff_unavailable` and `security_paths:*`; `security_paths_empty` fell through to the `code_review="always"` complexity split, letting an empty `security_paths` list merge low-complexity work with zero reviews. Folded it into the same branch (one review on `_security_review_tier(t)`, checklist forced) and updated the docstrings on `gate()` to match.
3. **Per-module glob list** — replaced the enumerated `orchestrator/*.py` file list in `.orchestrator/pool.toml` and `DEFAULT_SECURITY_PATHS` with a single `orchestrator/*.py` glob, so new modules (e.g. `cli.py`) are covered without a config edit.

## Files changed
- `orchestrator/daemon.py`
- `.orchestrator/pool.toml`
- `tests/test_daemon.py`

## Test output (failures only)
None — all 74 tests in `tests/test_daemon.py` pass, including the three new ones (`test_changed_paths_rename_matches_old_path`, `test_empty_security_paths_uses_security_tier_and_checklist`, `test_security_glob_covers_cli`) and the fixed `test_one_review_for_security_path` (updated to expect `security_paths:orchestrator/*.py` instead of the old literal filename, since the matched glob changed under item 3). `.claude/hooks/tests-green.sh` exits 0.

Committed on `task/T-0225` as `34d8f8a`, with `6005a54` and `d8531a3` beneath it.
